        # Each chosen set bit can be reduced in exactly k-i operations
        remaining_operations = k - i
        # Calculate the number of ways to distribute remaining_operations among the i set bits
        ways_to_distribute = comb(i + remaining_operations - 1, remaining_operations)
        # Add the product to the result
        result = (result + ways_to_choose * ways_to_distribute) % MOD
    
    return result

def count_special_numbers(n, k):
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    bin_n = bin(int(n, 2))[2:]
    length = len(bin_n)
    
    # Initialize dp array

            if j < k:
                new_dp[j] = (new_dp[j] + dp[j]) % MOD
        dp = new_dp
